translations.web: “ ‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.
translations.bsb: If a countryman among you becomes destitute and sells himself to you, then you must not force him into slave labor.
translations.kjv: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
translations.asv: And if thy brother be waxed poor with thee, and sell himself unto thee; thou shalt not make him to serve as a bond-servant.
